'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2 Aaron Nelson LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Aaron Nelson]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' The Other Step
* '''Username:''' Ardog2003
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
